title: feat(studio): the Studio app reads 应用搭建 in Chinese and App Studio in English
body:
Fixes #37566

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：所有用户在中文界面看到 Studio 叫「应用搭建」，英文界面叫「App Studio」——Studio 左上角的标志、应用切换菜单里「在应用搭建中查看 / View in App Studio」、顶栏的「在应用搭建中设计 / 编辑某应用」入口都改了；地址和权限名不变。
- 为什么做：App Studio 改版（第三阶段）的显示名，按维护者定下的「中文应用搭建、英文 App Studio、只改显示」。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是某个语言里还显示旧名「Studio」，不影响任何功能，可以直接撤回。
- 要你做的：无。

## What changes

Display text only (ADR-0084, the 2026-11-26 position amendment). Identifiers, the `/studio` address, permission names (`studio.access`) and package and API names are untouched; `skills/**` and `studio-design/**` components are untouched.

- **App label** — `STUDIO_APP.label` is `App Studio`. In `packages/platform-objects` translations, `zh-CN` reads 应用搭建 and `zh-Hant` reads 應用搭建. The other eight packs (`ar`, `de`, `es-ES`, `fr`, `ja-JP`, `ko`, `pt-BR`, `ru`) used the Latin product name and now read `App Studio`. Each pack's recorded source hash for `apps.studio.label` is re-recorded for the new source, because all ten were re-translated in this change. Without that, `withSourceFallback` would serve the English source in the Chinese UI.
- **Studio brand (top-left mark)** — `engine.studio.mark` in the Studio namespace (en `App Studio`, zh 应用搭建). This is the key that `StudioBackToApp` already reads, so **no new key was needed**. The #37456 brand should reuse `engine.studio.mark`.
- **`console.studio.title`** (the AppHeader `studio` crumb) — renamed in all eleven UI packs.
- **Doors into Studio from the app switcher and the top bar** — `topbar.viewInStudio` / `designInStudio` / `openAppInStudio` and `layout.appSwitcher.editAppInStudio` / `openAppInStudio`, renamed in all eleven UI packs. Chinese packs read 在应用搭建中…; the others swap `Studio` for `App Studio` inside the existing sentence.

## Tests

- New: `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/studio-display-name.test.ts`. It keeps `STUDIO_APP.name === 'studio'` and checks the **served** label (after `withSourceFallback`) in all eleven locales.
  - Ablation: putting back the old `zh-CN` digest turns it red (`Expected "应用搭建", Received "App Studio"`). This is evidence that the hash re-record is load-bearing.
- Updated pins that read the real packs:
  - `ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/residue-namespaces-3546.test.tsx` (`topbar.designInStudio`);
  - `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/SidebarAppMenu-36112.test.tsx` (zh `topbar.viewInStudio`);
  - the `console.studio.title` reason in `untranslated-identity-4376.test.ts`.

## Acceptance notes

- **The app switcher has no Studio app row on a stock boot.** This is by design: `@objectstack/studio` is not default-loaded (RUNNER notes, `dev-plugin.ts`). The switcher names Studio only through its door, which now reads 「在应用搭建中查看」 / "View in App Studio". `STUDIO_APP.label` reaches the UI only where the Studio app is installed.
- **The Studio tab title is the bare product name** (`ObjectOS`, measured). It does not name the app, so there is nothing to rename there.
- **Not renamed, left for the phase-5 wording pass or a follow-up card:**
  - About 30 sentences per pack mention Studio in prose, for example "unpublished changes in Studio", `common.editInStudio`, `console.studio.accessRequired` and the Studio-namespace refusal sentences.
  - The `defaultValue: 'View in Studio'` literal in `SidebarAppMenu.tsx`. It is a fallback that is used only when the key is missing, and it sits outside this card's file surface.
  - The `packages/apps/studio` manifest `name: 'Studio'`, which is a package name.
  - The `label: 'Studio'` example in `content/docs/ui/apps.mdx`.
- **Locales the ruling does not name:** zh-Hant follows zh-CN (應用搭建), and the Latin-name packs follow English (`App Studio`), as they did before.

## Verification

Read first (risk order):

1. `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/zh-CN.source-hashes.ts`. The `apps.studio.label` digest is the hunk that decides what the Chinese UI is served. The same digest is used in all ten tables.
2. `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/zh.ts`, `engine.studio.mark`. This is the brand the top-left reads.
3. `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/de.ts` and `ja.ts`, the door sentences. These are the two packs whose word order differs from English.

Two-minute check: open `/_console/studio/PACKAGE_ID` in a Chinese UI. The top-left reads 「‹ 返回应用 · PACKAGE · 应用搭建」, and the app menu in any app reads 「在应用搭建中查看」 or 「编辑应用」. Screenshots (Chromium, deviceScaleFactor 2, showcase) are in the seat's `topic-37424/cards/shots-37566/` folder.
